sections.h2: What Shaka Guide tours cost with the code
parts: Each tour is a one-time purchase that you download to your phone and keep. These were the prices on shakaguide.com:

sections.h2: 1. Buy the island bundle if you'll take two tours or more
parts: Every Hawaii island bundle costs $34.99, about the price of one and a half single tours. Shaka Guide lists the tours in each bundle at their single prices, so the saving is easy to check:

list: Maui: 6 tours worth $124.94 for $34.99, including Classic, Loop and Reverse Road to Hana, Sunrise at Haleakala and Sunset and Stargazing Haleakala.
Big Island: 5 tours worth $102.95 for $34.99, including Hawaii Volcanoes National Park.
Oahu: 6 tours worth $93.94 for $34.99, including Grand Circle Island and the Legendary North Shore Loop.
Kauai: 4 tours worth $82.96 for $34.99, including Waimea and Na Pali.

parts: If you only want the Road to Hana, the single tour with the code ($21.24) is cheaper. If you also plan to drive up Haleakala, the Maui bundle with the code ($29.74) covers both for less than the two single tours cost.

sections.h2: 2. Look at the two big collections for long trips
parts: Shaka Guide sells two larger collections, both marked as Black Friday deals when we checked:

list: The Hawaii Tour Collection: all 21 Hawaii tours for $59.99 (shown as $79.99 before the sale). It suits a trip to two or more islands.
The Ultimate National Park Tour Collection: 55 tours for $114.99 (shown as $199.99 before the sale). National park tours cost $14.99 to $22.99 each, so it pays off from about seven parks.

parts: The Black Friday page says the offer can't be combined with other promotions, so expect the code not to take more off these two collections while the sale runs.

sections.h2: 3. Buy on the website, not through an app store
parts: Shaka Guide's own sale terms say its website discounts don't apply to App Store, Google Play, Viator, Go City and other resellers. Buy on shakaguide.com, check out with the code, then open the receipt email on your phone: it has a download link and a redeem code (it starts with SG_) that unlocks the tours under My Stuff in the app.

Tours are digital, so there's nothing to ship. Shaka Guide's terms say payments are non-refundable except as the terms provide, and that refunds under its money-back satisfaction guarantee are at its discretion. Contact its support (by phone, chat or email from the support page) before disputing a charge.

Each tour includes offline audio, an offline map, turn-by-turn directions and a list of stops and nearby sights. Download it over Wi-Fi before you set out: after that it works without cell service. The app works with Apple CarPlay but not Android Auto, according to Shaka Guide's FAQ. The Black Friday page also says tours never expire.

faq: Is there a Shaka Guide discount code?
Yes. Code {code} takes {pct} off tours bought on shakaguide.com. Enter it in the discount box at the website checkout.
Is there a Shaka Guide promo code or coupon code?
For Shaka Guide, a promo code, a coupon code and a discount code are the same thing: {code} for {pct} off. It works the same whether you search Shaka Guide, ShakaGuide or the Shaka Guide app.
How much does a Shaka Guide tour cost?
Single tours cost $6.99 to $24.99 on shakaguide.com (November 22, 2026). Most national park tours are $14.99 to $18.99, and each Hawaii island bundle is $34.99. The app is free.

The Classic Road to Hana tour costs $24.99, or $21.24 with {pct} off. The Maui bundle, with it and five other Maui tours, is $34.99, or $29.74 with the code.

The Grand Circle Island tour costs $19.99, or $16.99 with the code. The Oahu bundle of 6 driving and walking tours costs $34.99, or $29.74 with the code.
Is the Shaka Guide bundle worth it?
If you'll take two tours or more on one island, yes: each island bundle costs $34.99, against $82.96 to $124.94 for its tours bought one by one.
Does the Shaka Guide code work on Black Friday deals?

Shaka Guide's Black Friday page says its offer can't be combined with other promotions, so the code may not take more off the Hawaii Tour Collection ($59.99) or the Ultimate National Park Tour Collection ($114.99) during the sale.
Can I use the code in the Shaka Guide app?

Use it on shakaguide.com. Shaka Guide says its website discounts don't apply to App Store, Google Play or reseller purchases. After you buy, the redeem code in your receipt unlocks the tours in the app.
Can I get a refund from Shaka Guide?
Its terms say payments are non-refundable except as the terms provide, and that refunds under its satisfaction guarantee are at Shaka Guide's discretion. Contact its support first.
Why isn't my Shaka Guide discount code working?

Check that you're checking out on shakaguide.com rather than in an app store, that the code is typed exactly as {code}, and that no sale price is already applied: sale offers can't be combined with other codes.
